description: Arpeggiator fed from polyphonic pitch and gate — patch it straight to Rack's MIDI-CV

params.text: Up, down, pendulum, pendulum repeat, in order, random, shuffle
Output gate length, as a proportion of the clock period
Latches the arpeggio so it keeps playing after every input gate has fallen

inputs.text: One note per pulse; required, or nothing happens
Restarts playback on the next clock
A gate going high on a channel of GATE adds the pitch on that channel of V/OCT to the arpeggio

outputs.text: The outputs are monophonic. Patch into ASSIGN to play them through a polyphonic voice

notes: nothing plays until a clock arrives at CLOCK; notes are added by gates on the channels of GATE, taking their pitches from the matching channels of V/OCT
menu: Use new notes — notes played while the arpeggio is running join it On arpeggio restart or Immediately
Max gate length — the GATE knob is read against the Clock interval, or as Fixed (500ms), which ignores the clock

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
